text:
Priya (CSM): FYI — ACME Health (AC-4421) emailed: considering downgrading to Basic next renewal. Usage down ~45% last 30d. Need a short save plan we can run this week.

Ethan (Onboarding): did they finish the events instrumentation? I remember their analyst hit blockers in week 2.

Priya (CSM): No — analytics event hammering never completed. They also said docs were confusing for custom templates. Contact: leah@acmehealth, exec sponsor unclear.

Marta (Success Ops): Can we map a 2-week triage + 8-week enablement save? Quick checklist draft below — we can iterate.

Marta (Success Ops): ```
Save Plan (AC-4421) — 10/Week sprint
1) 48h triage call (Priya + Onboarding)
2) Re-run instrumentation playbook (Ethan)
3) Two 1:1 enablement sessions (weeks 1 & 3)
4) Exec ROI review (week 6)
5) Temporary credit (billing) if gaps persist
Success metrics: +25% usage week 3, +50% week 6, exec review scheduled
Rollback criteria: no usage recovery by week 8 => propose downgrade path
```

Priya (CSM): This looks good. For the billing credit, cc'ing Lydia to approve up to 20% for retention. @Lydia can you confirm?

Lydia (RevOps): I can approve a one-time 20% credit for 90 days for mid-market saves, but need an ROI snapshot and the exec review invite before issuing. Put together a short one-pager and tag me.

Ethan (Onboarding): I'll own the instrumentation run. ETA to customers: schedule triage call today and run a remote session Wed. onboarding-bot will post invites.

onboarding-bot: Meeting scheduled: ACME Health triage — Wed 14:00 PT. Link: https://meet.prod/acme/triage (automated) :calendar: 

Priya (CSM): Also want to capture qualitative feedback — short NPS + 3-question product feedback after session. Marta — can you add to the playbook?

Marta (Success Ops): Added survey snippet to playbook. Snippet: "What feature blocked you? (free text) — How often would improved templates save your team time? (0-10) — Would an exec ROI review change your renewal decision? (Y/N)"

Priya (CSM): Great. I'll run the triage, push the survey same day, and follow up with exec scheduling. If we hit the ROI target by week 6, we aim to keep them on Pro. If not, prepare downgrade path and messaging.

Ethan (Onboarding): Copy. I'll post session notes and instrumentation checklist in this thread after Wed.

Lydia (RevOps): Once you have session notes + one-pager, @me and I'll clear billing change and draft the downgrade comms for legal.

Priya (CSM): Thanks team — short-term objective: prevent churn this renewal. Logging action items: 1) Priya schedule triage (done), 2) Ethan instrumentation (Wed), 3) Marta playbook + survey (done), 4) Lydia approve credit after ROI one-pager. Will update thread after Wed. :thumbsup:
